entities.name: PMID:25428027
observations: Reports 6-benzylthioinosine effects on Wnt signaling and differentiation in HL-60 AML cells; pathway evidence is pharmacological.

entities.name: 6-benzylthioinosine
observations: Also termed 6-BT in the reported AML differentiation study.

entities.name: Wnt signaling
observations: In HL-60 cells, the study reported reduced canonical Wnt signaling and increased noncanonical Wnt/Ca2+ signaling after 6-BT; pathway inhibitors altered differentiation.

entities.name: 6-BT/Wnt in HL-60
observations: In HL-60 cells, 6-BT-associated Wnt changes and pharmacologic pathway manipulation support a role for canonical and noncanonical Wnt signaling in induced differentiation; this does not establish causation in primary AML cells.
